steps.prompt: Tom is $8$ and his sister is $5$. How many years older is Tom? In $2$ years, how many years older will he be?

cards.title: Move both numbers
cards.body: The difference between two numbers stays the same if you add the same amount to both. $62 - 38$: add $2$ to both to get $64 - 40 = 24$. Now the sum is easy.

steps.text: Add $1$ to both numbers so $29$ becomes $30$.
Now take away the round number.

cards.title: Why it works
cards.body: Picture the two numbers on a number line. Sliding both the same distance along the line keeps the gap between them the same, like two people the same distance apart walking together.

prompts: Explain why adding the same number to both numbers keeps the difference the same.
